title: PermitWeave
description: Allocate visits against overlapping capacity windows, inspect gaps, and replay versioned decisions.
visual: Capacity → Coverage
details: Earliest-expiring capacity allocation with idempotency keys, revision checks and a replayable audit chain. Synthetic visits; browser-saved workspace.

title: DeltaLens
description: Investigate release-associated latency shifts with control-adjusted effects and visible uncertainty.
visual: Change → Evidence
details: Deduplicated telemetry, release windows, exploratory confidence intervals and overlapping-change warnings. Synthetic telemetry; correlation does not establish causation.

title: Kiln
description: Search constrained batch sequences and inspect resource, precedence and lateness decisions.
visual: Constraints → Sequence
details: Real Lua optimization with an admissible lower bound, feasible incumbent and honest search-budget certificate. Single-machine synthetic model; optimum tested against an independent oracle.

title: JMCRM-AI Revenue Copilot
description: Explain six sales signals, review outreach and move conversations through a persistent, inventory-aware workflow.
visual: Signal → Conversation
details: The actual C# and EF Core core produces duplicate-safe recommendations, preserves edited drafts, enforces workflow transitions and replays audited decisions. Fictional customers; browser-saved journal.

title: Reconciliation Engine
description: Match exact-cent records, inspect historical prices and FIFO lots, and keep every exception decision traceable.
visual: Records → Evidence
details: Maximum-cardinality minimum-cost matching with equal-optimum holdback, strict account/currency boundaries, as-of pricing and FIFO shortage quarantine. Synthetic close; browser-saved review journal.

title: Market Analysis on News Sentiments
description: Explore ticker-level news sentiment, technical indicators and comparative machine-learning backtests.
visual: News context, market features and model comparison across training, test and out-of-sample periods
details: Python notebooks merge daily sentiment summaries with technical features and compare logistic regression, decision trees, random forests and XGBoost. Includes archived with/without-news plots and held-out test and out-of-sample artifacts. The current notebook feature list keeps sentiment columns commented out; the research guide explains the saved configuration and reproduction limits.

title: DockProof
description: Compile typed packing policies, compare shipment impact, and approve passing cartons with traceable review.
details: Typed AST, constant folding and a stack VM checked against an independent interpreter; policy and carton changes invalidate affected approvals. Synthetic cartons; browser-saved revision journal.
visual: Policy → Proof

title: FolioTrace
description: Search source regions with explainable scores and publish reviewed document corrections.
details: Custom incremental postings, numeric BM25 reference and versioned page/box citations; draft correction, review and publication gates. Synthetic source documents; browser-saved journal.
visual: Region → Citation

title: Tidemark
description: Process event-time windows, review alerts and recover exact telemetry state from compact checkpoints.
details: Actual Rust WASM, monotonic watermarks, late-data quarantine, duplicate/conflict fencing and checksummed delta codec. Independent window oracle and recovery tests. Synthetic stream; browser persistence, no physical-device claims.
visual: Stream → Checkpoint

title: RelayLab
description: Rehearse webhook retries, lease expiry and circuit cooldowns with a deterministic, replayable delivery journal.
details: Custom typed queue core, tenant concurrency caps, stale-worker fencing and reviewed dead-letter redrive. Synthetic responses; browser-local journal, no external delivery or authentication claims.
visual: Rehearse tenant-scoped delivery failure with logical-clock retry/circuit semantics and fenced workers

title: RivetSync
description: Merge construction records against a common history, resolve conflicting fields and commit dependency-safe changes.
details: Three-way field/record merging, parent-order validation, real atomic SQLite materialization, snapshot hash checks, audit and undo. Synthetic records; browser journal and per-request in-memory database.
visual: Resolve divergent construction master-data edits while preserving relational dependencies and atomic reviewed commits

title: PrismIndex
description: Search exact descriptor neighbors, inspect radius groups and review duplicates before exporting canonical assets.
details: Actual Go WASM vantage-point tree, triangle-inequality pruning, deterministic ties, union-find suggestions and reviewed canonical export. Synthetic numeric descriptors; proximity is not semantic image similarity.
visual: Exact numeric-descriptor neighbor search with reviewed duplicate canonicalization and reproducible index maintenance

title: StrataLog
description: Ingest ordered event batches, recover interrupted writes and export verified snapshots from a durable local CLI.
details: Checksummed atomic batch WAL, contiguous stream offsets, duplicate-conflict fencing and actor serialization. Torn-tail recovery, checkpoint compaction and process-fault verification. Native code-only tool; no hosted service or multi-node durability claim.
visual: Ordered batches → checksummed frames → recovered offsets and snapshots

title: Cutline
description: Optimize finite cutting stock, reserve bars, record completed cuts and return reusable remnants to inventory.
details: Bounded exact stock assignment with kerf, honest search certificates, transactional reservation/completion and material conservation. Independent exhaustive oracle and failure checks. Original synthetic stock; browser-saved journal replayed through the real Python/SQLite core.
visual: Finite stock → proven cut placement → conserved products, kerf and remnants

title: VectorGarden
description: Train two tiny neural towers, inspect real gradients and evaluate retrieval on held-out synthetic queries.
details: Actual symmetric contrastive loss, normalized embeddings, manual backpropagation and deterministic Adam in a Web Worker. Finite-difference checks, complete optimizer/RNG checkpoints and per-class holdout evaluation. Synthetic numeric vectors; no natural-language model or real-world accuracy claim.
visual: Paired towers → real learning curve → held-out retrieval and verified gradients

title: GrainLab
description: Explore dimensional service telemetry, correct records and trace every rollup to its exact inputs.
details: Sparse eight-mask cube with exact retractions, integer aggregates, nearest-rank percentiles and cohort lineage. Replayable browser-local checkpoints and version-fenced edits; small-cohort display suppression is not a security boundary. Original synthetic data.
visual: Request records → reversible dimensional rollups → exact cohort lineage

title: VeilLedger
description: Narrow disclosure scopes, bind independent reviews to exact payloads and issue verifiable audit receipts.
details: Python/SQLite transactional replay, scoped field projection, independent two-review transitions, invalidation on revision and immutable release/withdrawal receipts. Synthetic role rehearsal with browser-owned logs; no authentication, legal compliance or secure-transfer claim.
visual: Narrow scope → reviewed projection → immutable receipt and audit trail

title: SpanPack
description: Compress integer signals, seek individual blocks and quarantine damage while preserving sample positions.
details: Actual Zig/WASM adaptive raw or delta-RLE codec with checksummed metadata/blocks, strict staging, random seek and explicit damaged-block import. Differential decoder tests and reproducible measured compression/timing tradeoffs. Synthetic integer signals; CRC32 is not cryptographic authenticity.
visual: Integer signal → independent checked blocks → exact seek and explicit quarantine

title: BoundedRun
description: Execute dependency graphs under explicit permissions, retry ceilings and spend limits.
details: Deterministic capability-limited scheduling with idempotency keys, bounded retries, portable checkpoints and an append-only decision trace. Synthetic tools in a browser-local rehearsal; no autonomous external actions.
visual: Declared capabilities → bounded transitions → replayable decision trace

title: TemporalMint
description: Rebuild historical features from only what was knowable, then audit leakage and correction impact.
details: SQLite point-in-time joins, revision-aware materialization, exact lineage and bounded correction backfills. Original synthetic logistics events; the deployed API uses an in-memory request database and makes no production feature-store claim.
visual: Event revisions → cutoff-safe rows → bounded backfill evidence

title: TwinTrace
description: Train two neural towers in the browser, inspect rankings and test counterfactual exclusions.
details: Separate TensorFlow.js query and item towers with pairwise logistic training, hard-negative inspection, exact dot-product ranking checks and counterfactual filtering. Synthetic profiles and artifacts; no real-world recommendation-quality claim.
visual: Profile tower + item tower → learned space → exact retrieval audit

title: Loadstone
description: Optimize a microgrid dispatch, compare outage scenarios, then review and rehearse a recoverable plan.
details: Exact integer dynamic programming over battery charge and generator ramp state, checked against 240 independent oracle cases. Version-bound review, interruption recovery and transactional operation receipts. Synthetic, lossless model; browser-local workspace; no physical device control.
visual: Energy balance → exact dispatch → recoverable rehearsal

title: PatchBay
description: Trace runtime dependency exposures and apply reviewed remediation rehearsals with transactional rollback.
details: Native dependency-remediation workbench with SCC analysis, shortest exposure paths and exact compatible weighted set-cover search. SQLite WAL, explicit review, idempotent receipts, recovery and integrity exports. Verified with 300 independent comparisons and six-process receipt races; no real package changes or security certification.
visual: Dependency graph → exact remediation → transactional evidence

title: ProofHarbor
description: Follow linked evidence, retain contradictory observations and review a recoverable, citation-checked dossier.
details: Lexical and bounded graph retrieval with exact quotations, supersession filtering and explicit unresolved contradictions. Real LangGraph SQLite checkpoints and LangChain retrieval pipeline. Single-user browser journal reconstructs request-local state; deterministic extractive output, no model API or causal inference.
visual: Source evidence → graph paths → reviewed dossier
